name: AI Commerce Vocabulary
description: An interactive knowledge base explaining how AI discovers, evaluates, trusts, and recommends e-commerce stores, built from 66 defined terms and the relationships between them.

hasDefinedTerm.name: AI Commerce Score™
hasDefinedTerm.description: The single 0 to 100 number measuring how well AI shopping agents can understand, trust, and recommend a store.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Recommendation Share™
hasDefinedTerm.description: The percentage of high-intent buying prompts in which a brand appears in AI recommendations.

hasDefinedTerm.name: AI Visibility Risk™
hasDefinedTerm.description: The score zone below 50. Stores here are systematically excluded from AI shopping recommendations.

hasDefinedTerm.name: AI Commerce Graph™
hasDefinedTerm.description: The complete network of relationships between brands, products, trust signals, buyer intents, and AI recommendation systems. The infrastructure Atom Foundry maps.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Recommendation Routing™
hasDefinedTerm.description: How AI systems decide which brand receives which buyer query. Not whether you are in the graph, but how traffic flows through it to you.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Persistent Merchant Identity™
hasDefinedTerm.description: How consistently AI systems understand your brand across platforms and over time. High PMI means every AI system knows the same accurate story about you.

hasDefinedTerm.name: AI Trust Layer™
hasDefinedTerm.description: The complete set of signals AI checks before considering a brand for recommendation. Trust verification happens before any scoring or matching.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Semantic Commerce Layer™
hasDefinedTerm.description: The infrastructure of intent-aligned product language that bridges what a store sells and how buyers ask AI to find it.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Machine-Readable Commerce™
hasDefinedTerm.description: E-commerce infrastructure structured so AI systems can parse, verify, and act on product and store data without human assistance.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Recommendation Confidence™
hasDefinedTerm.description: How strongly AI will recommend a store, from a weak mention to a confident first pick.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Semantic Clarity™
hasDefinedTerm.description: How clearly AI can understand what a store sells, who it serves, and why it is different.

hasDefinedTerm.name: AI Extractability™
hasDefinedTerm.description: How easily AI systems can pull structured answers from a store's content and pages.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Prompt Visibility™
hasDefinedTerm.description: Whether and how often a brand appears when buyers query AI systems with purchase-intent prompts.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Recommendation Velocity™
hasDefinedTerm.description: The rate of change in a brand's AI Commerce Score and Recommendation Share over time.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Recommendation Density™
hasDefinedTerm.description: How broadly a brand appears across adjacent buying intents, not just its primary category queries.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Hidden Authority™
hasDefinedTerm.description: A store with real authority but poor extractability. AI knows the brand but cannot pull answers to recommend it.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Intent Misalignment™
hasDefinedTerm.description: A brand with authority and good structure whose content does not match how buyers actually query AI in that category.

hasDefinedTerm.name: AI Trust Graph™
hasDefinedTerm.description: The network of external mentions, citations, reviews, and third-party validation that AI uses to verify and trust a brand.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Recommendation Position™
hasDefinedTerm.description: Where in an AI response a brand appears: first recommendation, supporting mention, comparison mention, or weak citation.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Recommendation Graph™
hasDefinedTerm.description: The relationship network connecting brands, products, trust signals, citations, and semantic relevance across AI systems.

hasDefinedTerm.name: AI Visibility™
hasDefinedTerm.description: Whether and how clearly an e-commerce store can be discovered, interpreted, and surfaced by AI shopping systems.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Agent-Readable Commerce™
hasDefinedTerm.description: E-commerce infrastructure specifically structured for autonomous AI shopping agents that browse, compare, and complete purchases without human input.

hasDefinedTerm.name: AI Commerce Infrastructure™
hasDefinedTerm.description: The machine-readable systems, trust layers, and semantic commerce architecture that enable AI-driven discovery and transactions at scale.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Agentic Commerce™
hasDefinedTerm.description: The model where AI agents autonomously browse, compare, evaluate, and complete purchases on behalf of buyers without requiring human input at each step.

hasDefinedTerm.name: AI Discoverability™
hasDefinedTerm.description: How easily and reliably AI systems can find, index, and surface a store in response to relevant buyer queries.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Merchant Interpretability™
hasDefinedTerm.description: How well AI systems can understand a merchant's identity, category, products, and positioning from available signals.

hasDefinedTerm.name: AI Recommendation Eligibility™
hasDefinedTerm.description: Whether a store has met the minimum threshold of signals required to be considered for AI shopping recommendations at all.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Commerce Knowledge Graph™
hasDefinedTerm.description: The semantic knowledge structure AI systems build around merchant entities, product categories, buyer intents, and commerce relationships.

hasDefinedTerm.name: AI Visibility Layer™
hasDefinedTerm.description: The complete stack of signals, structures, and systems that determine how visible a merchant is within AI commerce ecosystems.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Commerce Protocol Layer™
hasDefinedTerm.description: The standardized machine-readable protocols and file formats that enable AI systems to interact with e-commerce stores programmatically.

hasDefinedTerm.name: AI Readability™
hasDefinedTerm.description: How cleanly and completely AI systems can extract structured content from a store without relying on JavaScript or visual rendering.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Recommendation Visibility™
hasDefinedTerm.description: Whether a brand is visible to AI systems in the specific moment a buyer submits a purchase-intent query.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Trusted But Invisible™
hasDefinedTerm.description: A store with real authority and trust that AI cannot surface because its content is technically inaccessible.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Machine Trust Signals™
hasDefinedTerm.description: The specific crawlable signals AI uses to verify merchant trustworthiness before recommending a store to a buyer.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Recommendation Economy™
hasDefinedTerm.description: The emerging commercial model where AI systems, not search engines, control which brands and products buyers discover and purchase.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Recommendation Gap™
hasDefinedTerm.description: The measurable difference between a brand's current Recommendation Share and the share held by the category leader.

hasDefinedTerm.name: AI Recommendation Rate™
hasDefinedTerm.description: The percentage of tested buyer prompts in which a merchant receives any form of recommendation from an AI system.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Recommendation Authority™
hasDefinedTerm.description: The cumulative strength of signals supporting a merchant's eligibility, trust, and confidence for AI recommendation.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Recommendation Eligibility Score™
hasDefinedTerm.description: A scored measure of how close a store is to meeting the minimum threshold for AI recommendation eligibility.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Buyer Intent Graph™
hasDefinedTerm.description: The structured map of the real purchase-intent prompts buyers bring to AI, connected to the brands that satisfy each one.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Buyer Intent Coverage™
hasDefinedTerm.description: The share of a category's buyer intents for which a brand appears in AI recommendations at all.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Intent Authority™
hasDefinedTerm.description: How strongly AI associates a brand with a specific buyer intent, beyond merely appearing for it.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Recommendation Demand™
hasDefinedTerm.description: The volume of real buyer intent flowing to a category or intent cluster through AI systems.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Agent Transaction Readiness™
hasDefinedTerm.description: Whether an AI agent can complete a purchase on a store end to end, not just read it.

hasDefinedTerm.name: AI Actionability™
hasDefinedTerm.description: Whether the data on a store is structured precisely enough for an AI agent to act on it, not just read it.

hasDefinedTerm.name: ACO™
hasDefinedTerm.description: The process of optimizing product data, trust signals, and commerce infrastructure so AI systems can discover, evaluate, recommend, and transact products accurately.

hasDefinedTerm.name: GEO™
hasDefinedTerm.description: Generative Engine Optimization. The practice of structuring content so generative AI systems cite, quote, or recommend it directly inside their answers.

hasDefinedTerm.name: GEO vs SEO™
hasDefinedTerm.description: A comparison term. SEO optimizes for search engine rankings, GEO optimizes for being cited and recommended inside AI-generated answers.

hasDefinedTerm.name: AI Shopping™
hasDefinedTerm.description: The behavior of buyers using AI assistants like ChatGPT, Google AI Mode, or Alexa to research, compare, and purchase products instead of searching directly.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Semantic Commerce™
hasDefinedTerm.description: Ecommerce content and data described in the language and intent buyers actually use, rather than internal product naming.

hasDefinedTerm.name: AI Authority Signals™
hasDefinedTerm.description: The specific proof points, reviews, citations, and third-party mentions AI systems check to decide whether a brand can be trusted enough to recommend.

hasDefinedTerm.name: AI Commerce Audit™
hasDefinedTerm.description: A structured scan of a store's product data, trust signals, and technical infrastructure that scores how visible and recommendable it is to AI shopping systems.

hasDefinedTerm.name: AI Commerce Intelligence™
hasDefinedTerm.description: The layer of analysis that turns raw AI Commerce Score and Recommendation Graph data into specific, actionable fixes for a merchant.

hasDefinedTerm.name: AI Interpretability™
hasDefinedTerm.description: How accurately AI systems understand what a store actually sells, beyond simply being able to read the page.

hasDefinedTerm.name: AI Readiness™
hasDefinedTerm.description: How prepared a store's data, structure, and trust signals are for AI systems to read, evaluate, and recommend it right now.

hasDefinedTerm.name: AI Structured Signals™
hasDefinedTerm.description: The machine-readable markers, schema, and structured data a store exposes that let AI systems parse its products, pricing, and policies without guessing.

hasDefinedTerm.name: AI Trust Confidence™
hasDefinedTerm.description: How certain an AI system is that a store's trust signals are accurate and current enough to recommend without risk.

hasDefinedTerm.name: ChatGPT Shopping
hasDefinedTerm.description: ChatGPT's built-in product search and recommendation feature, which surfaces and compares merchant products directly inside conversational answers.

hasDefinedTerm.name: ChatGPT Visibility
hasDefinedTerm.description: Whether and how often a brand appears when buyers ask ChatGPT for product recommendations in its category.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Human View vs AI View™
hasDefinedTerm.description: The gap between what a human sees on a rendered page and what an AI crawler can actually extract from its underlying code.

hasDefinedTerm.name: llms.txt
hasDefinedTerm.description: A plain-text file at a store's root domain that gives AI systems a structured summary of what the site sells and how to interpret it.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Prompt Visibility Testing™
hasDefinedTerm.description: The practice of running real buyer prompts through AI systems to measure whether and how a brand appears in the responses.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Retrieval Intelligence™
hasDefinedTerm.description: How effectively an AI system retrieves the correct, most relevant store content to answer a buyer's query.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Shopify AI Readiness™
hasDefinedTerm.description: How prepared a Shopify store specifically is, given the platform's default theme and data structure, for AI shopping agents to read and recommend it.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Shopify AI Visibility™
hasDefinedTerm.description: Whether a Shopify store's products, pages, and trust signals are visible enough for AI shopping systems to discover it in the first place.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Unverified Visibility™
hasDefinedTerm.description: Appearing in AI search results or mentions without the trust signals to back the claim, a fragile, easily lost form of visibility.
